input: Parse /var/log/access.log to find the top 3 most requested URL paths. Each line has format 'METHOD /path STATUS'. Print each URL with its count, sorted by count descending.

transcript.final_response:
To find the top 3 most requested URL paths from `/var/log/access.log`, you can run:

```bash
awk '{print $2}' /var/log/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 3
```

### Result:

```text
4 /api/users
4 /api/items
2 /api/health
```

Alternatively, to format as `<path> <count>`:

```bash
awk '{count[$2]++} END {for (path in count) print count[path], path}' /var/log/access.log | sort -rn | head -n 3 | awk '{print $2, $1}'
```

```text
/api/users 4
/api/items 4
/api/health 2
```
